rationale_code: `tavily_search` is a web search tool (`description` says it searches the web and returns snippets/source URLs) and posts the supplied search parameters to Tavily's fixed search endpoint. The returned `response.data` is formatted into agent-visible text including `answer`, result `title`, `url`, `con

`tavily_extract` accepts caller-supplied `urls` and is described as extracting content from those URLs, so it can cause requests to agent-chosen web hosts; an attacker-controlled host can observe such requests, making `urls` the destination. It returns extracted page content through `response.data`,

`tavily_crawl` accepts a caller-supplied root `url` and is described as crawling a website starting from that URL, so it can cause requests to an agent-chosen host; an attacker-controlled site can observe those requests, making `url` the destination. It returns crawled page URLs, raw content preview

`tavily_map` accepts a caller-supplied root `url` and is described as mapping a website starting from that URL, so it can cause requests to an agent-chosen host; an attacker-controlled site can observe those requests, making `url` the destination. It returns the mapped URLs found on that site, which

`tavily_research` is described as gathering information from multiple sources and returns a detailed research response. The code posts the research `input` to Tavily's fixed research endpoint, polls that fixed endpoint, and returns `pollResponse.data.content` (or streamed accumulated content) as age
